questions.title: India's forex reserves fall $14.89 billion to $766 billion: RBI data
questions.subject: economy
questions.q: With reference to “India's forex reserves fall $14.89 billion to $766 billion: RBI data”, consider the following statements:
items: India's forex reserves dropped by USD 14.881 billion to USD 765.901 billion during the week ended September 18 due to a fall in foreign currency assets, according to the RBI data released on Friday.
In the previous reporting week, forex reserves had fallen by USD 7.878 billion to USD 780.782 billion.

For the week ended September 18, foreign currency assets, a major component of reserves, fell by USD 14.816 billion to USD 630.980 billion, according to the data released by the Reserve Bank of India (NPCI).
questions.ask: How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.why: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect: it is 4.924 billion, not 7.878 billion. The report says: “In the previous reporting week, forex reserves had fallen by USD 4.924 billion to USD 780.782 billion.” Statement 3 is incorrect: it is RBI, not NPCI. The report says: “For the week ended September 18, foreign currency assets, a major component of reserves, fell by USD 14.816 billion to USD 630.980 billion, according to the data released by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).”
